post.description: Public. Checks the platform limits before the app asks Firebase to send the SMS. A blocked phone or a running resend countdown answers 200 with `allowed: false`.

otpLength.description: Number of code boxes; never hardcode it in the app.

post.description: 404 `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` when the number is not linked to a salon (the app offers to register one); 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` when the owner removed the member.

200.description: The number belongs to an active member

post.summary: Log in with a Firebase ID token
post.description: The token must prove the phone. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), `OTP_BLOCKED` (429), `MEMBER_INACTIVE` (403), `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` (404). The profile carries role, salon and permissions for the app to cache.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh; keep only the newest.

post.description: Returns a new token pair and the current profile. Reusing an old refresh token ends every session of that login (401). A removed member gets 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` and all sessions end.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh; keep only the newest.

post.description: Revokes the refresh token and unlinks the device. Always succeeds for well-formed tokens.

put.description: Firebase app-instance id, FCM token and versions. Links the device to the signed-in member so the salon's booking requests reach it.

linked.description: The device is now tied to the signed-in account.

get.description: Public. Called at launch with the installed version: tells the app whether it must or may update, whether maintenance is on, plus OTP length/resend and the nearby radius.

message.description: In the request language; only while enabled.
